scientific_findings: Classical MobileNetV2 achieved 100.0% accuracy leveraging all 1280 deep feature dimensions.
Experimental 4-Qubit VQC achieved 95.56% accuracy using extreme 4-dimensional PCA compression.
Quantum classification stage utilizes only 23 parameters vs. 328,707 classical parameters (a >14,000x parameter reduction).
Classical simulation latency is 0.2 ms due to statevector/matrix multiplication on classical hardware.
Honest Conclusion: No quantum advantage is claimed. The system successfully demonstrates a working hybrid quantum-classical transfer pipeline on genuine leaf data.
